findings.summary: `--update --preset <X>` silently resets an existing harness's `loop.enabled` to the fresh default (False)
findings.suggestion: Forward loop through the preset-switch rebuild: include `"loop": answers.loop` so `_build_answers`' field allowlist cannot drop it (same treatment as autonomy=/toolchains=/comprehension_depth=).

reasoning.observe: cli.py:1520 _build_answers(...) rebuild takes a field allowlist without loop; rebuilt.model_copy(update=update) never sets loop.
reasoning.trace: make --update --preset Production on a loop.enabled:true harness: existing_loop applied at cli.py:380, then _apply_dimension_overrides rebuilds answers with default LoopConfig().
reasoning.infer: Rendered harness.yaml gets loop.enabled:false and the sweep deletes pristine loop files.
reasoning.conclude: Silent removal of the loop on a preset switch, the exact risk IRR-002 names; untested.

findings.summary: Existing loop value is read from disk twice and unconditionally re-applied on the successful-reuse path
findings.suggestion: Apply the existing_loop override only when reused is None (reinterview or fallback).

findings.summary: existing_loop resolved before a possibly long interview, then applied unconditionally after (TOCTOU)
findings.suggestion: Reuse pre_yaml_body or re-resolve immediately before applying.

reasoning.observe: read at cli.py:353, applied at :380 after interview() which may block on stdin.
reasoning.trace: A concurrent edit of loop.enabled during --reinterview is overwritten by the stale read.

findings.summary: Module's only render fixture now hard-codes loop.enabled=true, so the dangling-reference scan never sees the shipped loop-off default
findings.suggestion: Parametrize test_recommendations_resolve_to_skills over loop enabled True/False (drop hm-loop from the required set when off) so the dangling-reference scan runs against a loop-off render.

reasoning.observe: _rendered forces loop on; only test_loop_opt_in passes loop off.
reasoning.trace: The name-resolution invariant is checked only for the non-default arm.
reasoning.infer: A Next: banner pointing at hm-loop while off would pass.

findings.summary: Loop-off consistency of Codex skill Next: prose was only verified by hand
findings.suggestion: Automate the hand check as a parametrized test.

reasoning.trace: No automated loop-off scan of stage/skill templates.

findings.summary: test_ac009's body-diff half never executes: body_sha256 is always None pre-render
findings.suggestion: Render both blueprints (render(bp, tmp/.claude)) before hashing so a real body divergence can fail the test; then reconcile the allowed-diff list with the Codex hm-help body.

reasoning.observe: models.py:193 body_sha256=None until render.py sets it; test only calls synthesize().
reasoning.trace: _body_hashes stringifies None to 'None' on both sides.
reasoning.conclude: AC-009 body half is vacuous; a leak of loop state into agent/settings bodies would pass.

findings.summary: 읽을 수 없는 기존 파일의 fallback이 완성되지 않았다. harness.yaml에 잘못된 UTF-8이 있으면 resolver에 도달하기 전에 make가 종료되며, 앞선 호출만 고쳐도 answers loader에서 다시 실패한다. 두 reader도 UnicodeError를 처리하도록 하고 실제 decoding 실패를 CLI 테스트에 추가해야 한다. 현재 AC-010은 유효한 YAML의 잘못된 preset만 검사한다.
findings.evidence: 잘못된 UTF-8 바이트를 읽도록 재현하면 _resolve_existing_loop는 True를 반환하지만, 먼저 호출되는 _load_harness_yaml_body와 이후 answers_from_harness_yaml는 모두 UnicodeDecodeError를 발생시킨다.

findings.summary: AC-009의 본문 동일성 검사가 항상 통과한다. 양쪽 blueprint를 렌더링한 뒤 해시를 비교해야 한다. 이를 고치면 .agents/skills/hm-help/SKILL.md가 허용 목록 밖에서 변경되는 현재 SPEC 불일치도 드러난다. Codex 도움말을 listing surface로 허용할지 명시적으로 정리하고 테스트에 반영해야 한다.
findings.evidence: synthesize() 결과의 body_sha256은 모두 None이며 render() 이후에만 채워진다. 현재 _body_hashes는 이를 문자열 'None'으로 바꾼다. 실제 Codex hm-help의 help_body는 enabled/disabled 사이에 달라진다.

findings.summary: YAML에서 허용되는 비문자열 unknown key가 들어오면 의도한 loop 오류 메시지 대신 처리되지 않은 TypeError로 종료된다. 키를 정렬·출력하기 전에 문자열 여부를 검증하거나 repr로 변환하고, 숫자 및 혼합 타입 키를 AC-011 테스트에 추가해야 한다.
findings.evidence: parse_loop({1: True})는 join에서 TypeError를, parse_loop({'enabled': True, 1: False, 'extra': False})는 sorted에서 TypeError를 발생시킨다. CLI는 LoopConfigError만 처리한다.
